# Bible Gateway

> A comprehensive multilingual Bible search and study platform offering 240+ versions in 78 languages with audio, reading plans, and premium study resources.

Bible Gateway provides free and premium access to scripture across multiple translations and languages, supporting both text and audio formats. The platform includes mobile apps, devotionals, reading plans, and educational content to facilitate Bible study and engagement.

## Key Topics

- Bible translations
- Multilingual support (78 languages)
- Audio Bibles
- Scripture search
- Bible study tools
- Reading plans
- Devotionals
- Mobile apps
- NIV, KJV, ESV, NASB
- Premium subscriptions
- Verse of the Day
- Scripture engagement
- Bible commentaries
- Language versions
- Religious texts

## Core Scripture Access

- [Search for a Bible passage in 75 languages and 233 versions](https://www.biblegateway.com/passage): Primary passage search tool supporting 75 languages and 233 versions
- [240 online Bibles in 78 languages](https://www.biblegateway.com/versions): Directory of 240 Bible versions in 78 languages with text and audio formats
- [Audio Bibles](https://www.biblegateway.com/resources/audio): Audio Bible resource directory with multilingual support and professional narration
- [About Bible Gateway](https://www.biblegateway.com/about): Overview of Bible Gateway's searchable online Bible platform and mission

## Bible Study & Learning Resources

- [Reading Plans](https://www.biblegateway.com/reading-plans): Structured Bible reading plans across multiple translations
- [Scripture Engagement](https://www.biblegateway.com/resources/scripture-engagement): Scripture engagement tools and translation comparison resources
- [Resources Hub](https://www.biblegateway.com/resources): Hub for audio Bibles, commentaries, dictionaries, and Bible study tools
- [Bible Gateway News & Knowledge](https://www.biblegateway.com/learn): Educational hub with Bible news, study guides, and theological learning resources
- [Systematic Theology Resources](https://www.biblegateway.com/learn/bible-101/bible-study-tips/systematic-theology-resources): Guide to systematic theology basics and learning resources

## Devotionals & Daily Scripture

- [Devotionals](https://www.biblegateway.com/devotionals): Devotional content across multiple Bible versions
- [Verse of the Day](https://www.biblegateway.com/landing/verse-of-the-day): Daily verse subscription service with email delivery
- [Newsletters](https://www.biblegateway.com/newsletters): Newsletter signup for scripture access and Bible study tools

## Mobile Applications

- [Bible Gateway Mobile App](https://www.biblegateway.com/app): Mobile app providing scripture access across Bible versions
- [Bible Audio App](https://www.biblegateway.com/bible-audio-app): Audio-focused mobile app with narration and memorization tools

## Premium Features & Subscriptions

- [Bible Gateway Plus](https://www.biblegateway.com/plus): Premium subscription service with commentaries and advanced study resources

## Bible Version References

- [New International Version (NIV) Information](https://www.biblegateway.com/versions/New-International-Version-NIV-Bible): NIV translation information and version comparison reference
- [Audio Bible - NIV with Max McLean](https://www.biblegateway.com/audio/mclean/niv/Jer.17.7-Jer.17.8): Audio Bible playback for NIV with professional narration
